about_the_game:
About:

In a frozen zombie apocalypse, a father turning into a vampire must use supernatural powers to protect his daughter - but each hunt erodes his remaining humanity. When human blood becomes essential for survival, how can this vampire father keep his vow to 'never harm humans'? The zombies might ironically become his most honest allies...

Character Introductions:

Henry Tarnaki: A European man in his mid-40s. Before the zombie outbreak, he was a painter who loved skiing—introverted and gentle, often taking his daughter on ski trips. After the apocalypse, he fled with his daughter to the mountains, occasionally venturing into the city for supplies. Later, he was bitten by a mutated bat in the snowy wilderness, transforming into a vampire.

Rose Tarnaki: An 8-year-old girl, Henry’s daughter and a skilled skier. Cheerful, mischievous, and optimistic, she survives alongside her father in the mountains after the outbreak, relying on each other in this harsh world.

Luca Newman: A 30-year-old Asian survivor, slightly overweight. Near death, he was rescued by Rose but later betrayed her after discovering their well-stocked shelter. He informed Anderson Hill, the ruthless leader of a scavenger group, leading to a confrontation. Eventually, Luca mutated into the Zombie King and challenged Henry.

Anderson Hill: A European man in his mid-40s, formerly a soldier. After the outbreak, he formed an armed group to plunder supplies, known for his brutality and merciless tactics.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.00 GHz 或 AMD A10
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 3000
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.00 GHz 或 AMD A10
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 3000
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: This is a visual novel-style game. The story follows a father gradually turning into a vampire in a frozen zombie apocalypse, who must wield supernatural power to protect his daughter—yet each hunt erodes his remaining humanity. How can this vampiric father uphold his vow to 'never harm humans'?
supported_languages:
English*, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support
